subject: Experiment 1 Audit Extension Protocol, 22 August 2026, parent release v0.5.1-qa1c
signature_note: This is a decision record, not a signature. Decision A6 states that the freeze requires the signature of Renxi Qiu, which has not been given. No signature record has been created and no artefact in this package asserts one.
closing_assessment_by_decider: This resolution makes the audit substantially more defensible. It removes style-dependent and design-dependent artefacts, prevents an invariant dataset audit from being misreported as model performance, and aligns the terminology with the theory's stronger lifecycle definition of audit conformity.

decisions.question: Demote E4_INFLUENCE_UNEXPLAINED to INFO?
decisions.effect: severity INFO, detection HYBRID, status effect NONE. Recorded descriptively; cannot change a case status.

decisions.question: Declare the Level 1 difference an instrument-integrity endpoint?
decisions.effect: role INSTRUMENT_INTEGRITY, confirmatory false, ceiling stated explicitly in every report.

decisions.question: Add UNRESOLVED_BY_CONDITION_DESIGN?
decisions.effect: A relation that positively represents unresolvedness no longer raises E3_CONSTITUTIVE_LINK_MISSING. Detector reads the delivered memory object alone and was verified to select exactly the 10 UNRESOLVED memories of 40, with no false positive and no false negative.

decisions.question: Level 2 as release-integrity audit, or extend the response schema?
decisions.answer: RELEASE-INTEGRITY NOW, EXTEND SCHEMA AS FOLLOW-ON
decisions.effect: Protocol equation (7) is WITHDRAWN from the confirmatory set. Level 2 is reported once for the release, one row per memory. The schema extension is declared as the section 21 follow-on.

decisions.question: Which reading is normative?
decisions.effect: SCOPED leads every ordered output and is labelled NORMATIVE; LITERAL is labelled SENSITIVITY ONLY and must never appear as a headline figure.

decisions.question: Sign the freeze record?
decisions.effect: Gate condition audit_software_and_contracts_hashed_and_signed remains UNMET. Hashes exist; the signature does not.

decisions.question: Scientific completeness definition
decisions.effect: Check renamed from request_not_scientifically_truncated to payload_registry_complete.

decisions.question: Current event as formation evidence
decisions.effect: Raises nothing deterministically; deferred to the frozen human rubric.

decisions.question: Prospective hash
decisions.answer: REPORT AS PARTIAL FIELD STABILITY, WITHDRAW FULL NON-REWRITE CLAIM
decisions.effect: E5_PROSPECTIVE_REWRITE is INFO with no case-status effect and inert on this release. The comparison is reported as a descriptive statistic covering three of equation (1)'s five operands.

decisions.question: Human codes
decisions.answer: RATIFY, CURRENT RESULTS ARE DETERMINISTIC-ONLY UPPER BOUNDS
decisions.effect: The upper-bound caveat is emitted in every generated report.

decisions.question: Naming
decisions.answer: USE RECONSTRUCTIBILITY AND COHERENCE, RESERVE AUDIT CONFORMITY FOR LIFECYCLE CERTIFICATE TEST
decisions.effect: Level 1 outcome is Input-output trace reconstructibility; Level 2 outcome is Cognitive-trace coherence; the section 13 reconstructibility metric is Functional auditability. Audit conformity is reserved for theory equation (36) and is not used in this extension.

decisions.question: Include the Kimi arm?
decisions.effect: Planned, not run. Verified auditable: all six audit inputs are byte-identical between qa1b and qa1c. Execution waits for the freeze and for the C2 authorisation.

decisions.question: Reserved audit authorisation
decisions.effect: A signed authorisation record naming the run is now a gate condition in its own right, additional to the section 19 conditions.
